Name: (FS) Recolorable beanies
Author: LadyZomkie
Description:
Both beanies from the game are now recolorable with fashion sense. I mean, if you still have the vanilla beanies they themselves aren't recolorable, you have to add them with fashion sense instead (at least no inventory space is used).

There may be an issue with some hairstyles, I can't fix that, you'll have to pick a different hairstyle or learn to live with clipping. 😂

This is my first time doing this. I tried to fix every issue I found but if I missed something let me know. There seems to be at least ONE mod that makes the hat higher, and the hair transparent in some parts, but I couldn't figure out which one was causing it.
